verdict.rationale: Braintrust's own tracing records token usage and metadata on every request, and the product tracks cost in real time and offers a filterable logs table. That implies cost and usage can be sliced by custom metadata. However, no evidence explicitly documents attributing or aggregating cost by user, session, or feature via metadata keys. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-user/session/feature cost attribution, metadata-based cost grouping or dashboards, examples of setting user/session metadata, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: recording inputs, outputs, model parameters, latency, token usage, and metadata for every request
track latency, cost, and quality in real time
The **Logs** page displays all traces from your application in a searchable, filterable table.
